name: 'Arrow' I Missile
desc: Commonly known by its military designation, the Arrow is a small infrared strike missile that has become a mainstay of the Vanduul armory.

name: 'Bullet' II Missile
desc: Pilots in the Navy have developed a healthy respect for this infrared targeting Vanduul strike missile, formally designated Bullet.

name: 'Chaos' III Missile
desc: Naval flight instructors often include the heat seeking Chaos strike missile in Vanduul attack simulations citing that its speed and strength gives new recruits the proper respect for the enemy they will be facing.

name: 'Dragon' IV Missile
desc: Designated the Dragon, this Vanduul infrared tracking strike missile has a fearful reputation earned the number of destroyed Naval ships attributed to its destructive power.

name: 'WAR' Cannon
desc: This neutron cannon is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WAR'.

name: 'WARLORD' Cannon
desc: 'WARLORD' Cannon

name: 'WASP' Repeater
desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WASP'.

name: 'WEAK' Repeater
desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WEAK'.

name: 'WHIP' Cannon
desc: 'WHIP' Cannon

name: 'WRATH' Cannon
desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WRATH'.

name: 'WRATH' Cannon
desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WRATH'.

name: "Quantainium" Water Bottle
desc: Make others believe you have the ability to tap into the awesome power of quantainium with this novelty water bottle. Unscrewing the lid produces a eerie blue glow that will make others truly wonder what you've got inside.

name: 10-Series Greatsword Cannon
desc: KnightBridge Arms knows that when it comes to battle, having the right weapon can make all the difference. With its powerful ballistic rounds, the versatile, size two 10-Series Greatsword will see you through to the conflict's end thanks to it long range and high damage potential.

name: 11-Series Broadsword Cannon
desc: The 11-Series Broadsword from KnightBridge Arms is the size three ballistic autocannon pilots come to when they want the 3 D's: distance, dependability and damage.

name: 250-E Laser Pointer
desc: The 250-E is an intuitive aiming aid that produces a laser visible to you and others. NV-TAC built the attachment to be lightweight yet durable so it won't add extra weight to your weapon.

name: 2954 Luck's Favor Tankard
desc: Beautifully crafted from genuine wood with pewter accents, this Stella Fortuna themed tankard features a compass star and a reminder that "Luck Favors the Bold."

name: 2954 Tempt Fate Tankard
desc: Featuring a clover motif with an antique finish, this pewter and brass tankard is perfect for making a traditional Stella Fortuna toast to "Tempt Fate."

name: 5CA 'Akura'
desc: Behring's belief in balanced shield design is evident with the 5CA. This large shield generator is equally focused on providing acceptable shield health along with decent damage absorption.

name: 5MA 'Chimalli'
desc: Thanks to Behring's expert engineers, the 5MA 'Chimalli' shield generator balances the need for a solid regeneration rate with dependable damage absorption.

name: 5SA 'Rhada'
desc: The 5SA 'Rhada' delivers Behring's expert engineering and trusted performance to make it a worthy shield generator for any commercial ship.

name: 6CA 'Bila'
desc: "Built by Behring" is a phrase synonymous with quality. That's why so many around the Empire trust their 6CA 'Bila' large shield generator to provide them with solid performance, impressive durable, and an acceptable degree of stealth.

name: 6MA 'Kozane'
desc: Behring's ironclad reputation is almost as impenetrable as the shield produced by the 6MA 'Kozane'. If it's good enough for Behring, it's good enough for you.

name: 6SA 'Arbiter'
desc: Providing above average shield health and damage absorption, the 6SA 'Arbiter' has been a trusted component for centuries. Experience the Behring advantage by installing this small shield generator today.

name: 7CA 'Nargun'
desc: Commercial-grade shield generators don't get any better than the 7CA 'Nargun'. The component utilizes Behring's patented 'Freeze Flow' tech to keep its heat signature in check while increasing both its overall performance and durability.

name: 7MA 'Lorica'
desc: Trust a component that has been equipped on crafts for centuries - the 7MA 'Lorica'. Experience Behring's top-of-the-line shield generator on your ship today.

name: 7SA 'Concord'
desc: A top-of-the-line shield generator that runs loud and proud. What it sacrifices in stealth it more than makes up for with supreme durability and excellent performance. So, even if enemies see you coming, they'll have a hard time disabling Behring's 7SA 'Concord'.

name: 9-Series Longsword Cannon
desc: The entry level autocannon of the KnightBridge Arms Sword-line, the 9-Series Longsword fires a ballistic round designed for use against a variety of armored hostiles while allowing pilots to keep a healthy distance from targets.

name: A03 "Canuto" Sniper Rifle
desc: Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. The A03 delivers an impressive rate of fire for a sniper rifle that sacrifices accuracy for urgency when successive shots are required. Considering its renowned design and unique features, it's easy to see why the A03 has become a favorite of security professionals across the empire.

desc:
Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. desc: This magazine for the Gemini A03 sniper rifle holds fifteen 7mm rounds.

name: A23 Flight Helmet Woodland
desc: The A23 has been one of CDS' mainstay helmet systems for years. Built out of impact-resistant composite technology and a hardened laminate faceplate, the A23 is perfect for hazardous environment and basic EVA operations. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

name: AbsoluteZero
desc: Originally designed for racers, the AbsoluteZero cooler pushes performance to the limits. This high quality component from ACOM features a new coolant cycling system to keep your ship's systems cool over everything else.

name: Absolution Distortion Scattergun
desc: Deliver high distortion damage in close quarters with Preacher Armaments' Absolution scattergun. This size five weapon is an ideal loadout option for those interested in capturing or boarding their target.

name: Ace Interceptor Helmet
desc: The unique open-faced design makes the Ace Interceptor helmet a lightweight and liberating option for operating in atmosphere. It features precisely layered plating to protect the head from a variety of combat and environmental hazards and an impact resistant, anti-glare visor over the eyes. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

name: Ace Interceptor Racing Flight Suit
desc: Featuring a deceptively simple design, the Ace Interceptor flight suit is jet black with reinforced grey protective padding on the arms and legs. Basilisk's renowned craftsmanship make this flight suit durable and supremely comfortable, leaving no mystery as to why it's widely used by top pilots across the empire.

name: AD4B Ballistic Gatling
desc: The AD4B, Behring's take on the classic ballistic gatling, includes a crystal cycle firing mechanism in the the high speed rotary system to maximize efficiency for sustained engagements with minimal misfires. Next time an aggressor escalates a hostile situation, make them regret the decision by spinning up this overwhelming and effective weapon.

name: AD5B Ballistic Gatling
desc: The AD5B, Behring's take on the classic ballistic gatling, includes a crystal cycle firing mechanism in the the high speed rotary system to maximize efficiency for sustained engagements with minimal misfires. name: ADP Arms (Modified)
desc: This version of CDS' ADP arms has been modified from its original form. Revolutionary when first released, the ADP heavy armor system was heralded as the pinnacle of personal protection. Clark Defense Systems' maximalist design provides plenty of attachment points and excellent protection against the elements and enemy fire. CDS refined and reshaped the ADP line over the years, but many still consider the original ADP to be the touchstone of military-grade heavy armor.

desc: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife AdrenaPen can rapidly dispense doses of the synthetic adrenaline Demexatrine during emergency situations to help relieve muscle fatigue and symptoms related to being concussed. Use only as recommended.

name: Advocacy Interceptor Helmet
desc: The unique open-faced design makes the Advocacy Interceptor helmet a lightweight and liberating option for operating in atmosphere. It features precisely layered plating to protect the head from a variety of combat and environmental hazards and an impact resistant, anti-glare visor over the eyes. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

name: Advocacy Interceptor Racing Flight Suit
desc: Featuring a deceptively simple design, the Advocacy Interceptor is jet black with reinforced grey protective padding on the arms and legs. Basilisk's renowned craftsmanship make this flight suit durable and supremely comfortable, leaving no mystery as to why it's widely used by the Advocacy.

name: Agni
desc: Haulers have relied on Juno Starwerk's stellar industrial craftsmanship for centuries. The company constantly updates and improves the design of the Agni quantum drive to ensure it remains a top-of-the-line industrial component.

name: Aither
desc: Named for an ancient god of light and the heavens, the Aither quantum drive honors its namesake as it ferries people places their ancestors could never imagine. This classic RSI medium-sized component has graced civilian ships for centuries.

name: Algid
desc: The Reclaimer is a ship renowned for its ability to work long and hard. To help support even the most arduous salvaging projects, Aegis develop the bespoke Algid cooler.

name: Allegro
desc: Designed specifically for the 890 Jump, the Allegro quantum drive blends ArcCorp's expertise with Origin's exceptionally high standards, making it the ideal companion for a luxury cruise through the stars.

name: AllStop
desc: Gorgon Defender Industries first created the AllStop shield generator to hold off the Vanduul. They worked so well that many military crafts were known to prefer the AllStop. Just one of the many reasons to have one on your ship.

name: Arlington "Gamekeeper" Rifle
desc:
Gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks looked to classic ballistic designs to construct a long rifle steeped in the past and the future. The Arlington provides accurate marksmanship, an easy cycling of rounds thanks to the lever action design, and multiple fire modes. Artisans shaped the weapon's body by hand to create a piece that's equally fit for the mantle as it is on the frontier.

The Gamekeeper edition swaps the stock of the rifle to an elegant walnut wood.

name: Aspis
desc: Basilisk's Aspis industrial shield generator features durable design and reliable performance, earning it a place on Whitley's Guide 'Best Buy' list.

name: Assailant IV Missile
desc: The Assailant missile from Talon is a perfect weapon solution for precision strikes against motivated opponents.

name: Assailant IV-G Missile
desc: The Assailant missile from Talon is a perfect weapon solution for precision strikes against motivated opponents. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

name: Atlas
desc: Though it may seem commonplace today, Humanity's ability to travel across solar systems at quantum speeds was built upon a foundation of Roberts Space Industries' technology and craftsmanship. Now, space travel has reached even higher heights thanks to the top-of-class performance of RSI's Atlas pushing quantum drive technology farther than it's ever gone.

name: Attrition-1 Repeater
desc: The Attrition-1 laser repeater features Hurston Dynamics' unique cascade technology which provides increased performance while sustained laser fire is maintained. The result is a size one weapon that rewards a deft operator.

name: Attrition-2 Repeater
desc: When the battle is heating up, that's when Hurston Dynamics' cascade laser technology really shines. With the size two Attrition-2 repeater, an operator can utilize sustained bursts of laser fire in order to translate excess heat into greater weapon performance.

name: Attrition-3 Repeater
desc: Rather than limiting their weapon's performance to increase stability, Hurston Dynamics' cascade technology allows the operator to decide. While overheating is a risk, longer periods of sustained fire with the Attrition-3 laser repeater will increase performance as excess heat is translated into greater energy output.

name: Attrition-4 Repeater
desc: Hurston Dynamics has fully integrated it's cascade laser technology into their Attrition-line of repeaters. The size four Attrition-4 is no exception, operating at peak performance when near its maximum thermal capacity.

name: Attrition-5 Repeater
desc: More than a simple size five laser repeater, the Attrition-5 from Hurston Dynamics features advanced cascade technology to allow the weapon significant performance improvements the longer it sustains its energy output.

name: Attrition-6 Repeater
desc: With Hurston Dynamics' cascade technology, the Attrition-6 laser repeater maximizes it's combat potential. It's common for weapons to heat up when used heavily in combat, but what sets this size six repeater apart is that thermal energy is translating directly into increased offensive strength.

name: ATVS Repeater
desc: Mess with an aggressor's electrical system with the ATVS from Behring. This disruptive, non-lethal distortion repeater is only compatible with the nose-mount on the Aegis Vanguard.

name: Atzkav "Deadeye" Sniper Rifle
desc: The Atzkav is a unique precision sniper rifle from Lightning Bolt Co. Once the charging handle is engaged, it accurately fires a charged electron to deal significant energy damage that spreads to nearby conductive targets. This special pulse effect also leaves a residual charge in the strike area that increases damage delivered by subsequent electron shots. Alongside the rifle's special firing capabilities, the Atzkav is best known for its distinct barrel that crackles with energy when powering its next shot. The exclusive Deadeye edition is black with gold highlights.

name: Aves Arms
desc: Honor and embody the Tevarin aesthetic with the Aves armor. Cutting edge manufacturing techniques were used to place white, red, grey, and black plating perfectly to fit the Human form and evoke the shape language imbued into the Tevarin's iconic ships. This medium armor from CC's Conversions is both sensational and practical, providing solid protection while keeping you light on your feet. When paired with the Aves helmet, the suit combines for a striking and unforgettable look.

desc: A rich, creamy avocado mash layered with a sweet and spicy corn salad and served on spelt bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

name: Axiom L-22 Repeater
desc: Meticulous design makes the Axiom L-22 an ideal armament for the L-22 Alpha Wolf. Premium parts and cutting-edge manufacturing have created a laser repeater made to thrive in the heat of battle.

desc: Fear no frontier while wearing the Aztalan armor. This mixture of armor plating and reinforced fabrics will keep you safe yet swift on your feet. Tehachapi's masterful design gives the armor a subtle yet unmistakable frontier style that also providing ample storage. Suitable for everything from sand dunes to bustling backstreets, the Aztalan is the ideal choice for your next adventure.

name: Bacon Club Sandwich
desc: Two kinds of bacon - one thick cut and heavily smoked, the other crisp and sweet - join creamy aioli, roasted zucchini and bitter greens on white bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

name: Badami Helmet
desc: The Badami helmet from Caldera provides premium head protection with a tough polycarbonate shell and an anti-microbial liner. Allowing you to boldly brave untamed locales and explore the dark corners of space.

desc: Greycat Industrial has spent centuries refining the Baler salvage head into its current form that's both durable and precise even under the harshest of conditions. Experience why it's the standard salvage head for countless personal and large-scale industrial operations across the universe.

desc: Barricade your ship against external forces with the Basilisk Barbican. Originally fabricated for large industrial vessels, this shield generator has became quite popular due to its high damage absorption.

desc: A smoothie made with a fresh blend of berries.

name: Berserker Helmet
desc: Modern and ancient armor converge with the Berserker helmet. This wildly original armor from CC's Conversions features golden horns and wings, plus a face covering inspired by lamellar armor. Beneath these unique aesthetic flourishes, this heavy helmet provides supreme protection with plating that extends low enough to protect your neck. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

name: Black Mountain Sujin Tea (Medium Blend)
desc: Sujin root tea, native to Elysium IV, is a traditional Tevarin beverage and has been produced for thousands of years. Black Mountain steeps only premium roots to make their delicious brew.

name: Black Mountain Sujin Tea (Mild)
desc: Sujin root tea, native to Elysium IV, is a traditional Tevarin beverage and has been produced for thousands of years. Black Mountain steeps only premium roots to make their delicious brew.

name: Black Prism (8x Telescopic)
desc: Delivering accurate fire at long distances is a skill that comes with practice - and the use of a proper scope like Kastak Arms' Black Prism. Crafted with rugged, multi-coated crystalens to deliver bright, clear visuals, this 8x telescopic sight is completely at home on your favorite rifle.

name: BlastChill
desc: The BlastChill is a consumer-grade cooler from Lightning Power Ltd. It keeps your ship running without straining its signature, but is best known for a much mocked 2945 ad campaign that promised it was "Built to bring the chill."

name: Blizzard
desc: Navy mechanics worked with Aegis engineers to ensure the Blizzard met their specific needs. When it reached the commercial market, this top of the line, military-grade cooler became one of Aegis' top selling components.

name: BLOC
desc: Seal Corporation's BLOC shield generator was the first to use the company's revolutionary quantum core semiconductor to reduce the component's power draw without compromising performance.

name: Bo-Go (Angeli Original)
desc: Croshaw's signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Angeli Original' flavor provides a real "taste of home" thanks to its classic family recipe.

name: Bo-Go (Crawdad)
desc: Croshaw's signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Crawdad' flavor puts front and center the delicious crustacean loved by the people of Angeli.

name: Bo-Go (Hot and Sweet)
desc: Croshaw's signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Hot and Sweet' flavor brings layers of spice and rich molasses to the traditional recipe.

name: Bo-Go (Langoustine and Lamb)
desc: Croshaw's signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Langoustine and Lamb' flavor combines succulent langoustine tail meat with rich and hearty pieces of lamb in a lighter sauce that highlights them both.

name: Bokto Arms
desc: This Antium Armor was modified from its original version. Carefully-selected fangs and bones were mounted to the set to give it a primal look.

name: Bokto Core

name: Bolide
desc: The Bolide power plant from Aegis has logged innumerable hours of flight experience and is frequently used by the UEE Navy and security forces across the Empire.

name: Bologna Sandwich
desc: Artisanally crafted in the old-world tradition, our lightly smoked bologna is paired with a sharp mustard and layered between soft, buttery rice bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

name: Bolon
desc: Don't let lesser craftsmanship put you and your precious cargo at risk. The Bolon industrial quantum drive was built with durability in mind to keep it working when you need it most.

name: Bolt
desc: The RAMP Corporation continues their line of low emission quantum drives with the Bolt. This medium-sized component will blast you from one location to the next while producing a minimal signature.

name: Boomtube "Clanguard" Rocket Launcher
desc:
Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.

The Clanguard version has been modified with Vanduul materials and alien artifacts.

name: Boomtube "Mean Green" Rocket Launcher
desc:
Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.

The Mean Green version features a green tint.

desc:
Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.

This Ruby variant features a red tint.

name: Boomtube Rocket
desc: Made for the Boomtube launcher, this "rocket" is pretty much three grenades strapped together. Good luck!

name: Boomtube Rocket Launcher
desc: Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.

name: Boreal
desc: Designed to disperse the heat of battle, Aegis Dynamics' Boreal cooler is a military standard with the capacity to survive stressful situations.

name: BoreMax
desc:
The BoreMax helps focus laser power to reduce instability significantly, while also keeping clusters of valuable deposits together upon shattering. While it does make it more difficult and time-consuming to bypass the deposit's resistance, most miners find the extra safety and increased yield worth the extra effort.

Manufacturer Warning! Using more than one mining gadget per deposit can result in a catastrophic explosion.

name: BR-2 "Blacklist" Shotgun
desc:
Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. 

The Blacklist edition features a black finish.

name: BR-2 "Permafrost" Shotgun
desc: Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. This special Permafrost edition features blue and grey coloring reminiscent of a glacier under a blinding winter sky.

Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. The Purgatory Camo edition's grey-on-grey dressing creates a sleek, utilitarian profile.

name: Bracer
desc: For those looking for a solid, dependable mid-line cooler, you can't do much better than Aegis' Bracer. This small-frame cooler system offers solid performance and durability to keep your ship firing on all cylinders.

name: Brandt Module
desc: Strategically use the Brandt to boost a mining laser's power for sixty seconds. The modulated beam also has the benefit of helping make rocks that shatter less hazardous, though the deposit will be more resistant to the laser's affect overall.

name: Breakfast Dog
desc: Scrambled eggs make this hot dog great to get you going any time of day.

name: Breakneck S4 Gatling
desc: While the exact origins and designer are unknown, the Breakneck is built off an existing ballistic gatling then modified to cause more mayhem. When the Breakneck starts shooting, the fun begins.

name: Breton
desc: The Breton embodies exactly what Juno Starwerk engineers wanted out of an industrial power plant - utilitarian, easy to repair and extremely powerful. You'll be hard pressed to find a better balance of performance and durability from a unit this size.

name: Brightspot Flashlight Purple
desc: The Brightspot flashlight embodies Klaus & Werner's engineering ethos. A simple and sturdy design built to withstand intense combat and environmental conditions means the Brightspot always works when you need it most. This special edition projects a purple circle that makes the beam less conspicuous from a distance.

name: BRVS Repeater
desc: Only Vanguard owners can equip this unique version of Behring's line of ballistic repeaters to the nose of their ship. The BRVS is carefully calibrated so its ballistic barrage would fire fast enough to provide maximum target saturation while its improved venting reduces frequent overheating.

name: BUL-H4 Ammo Carrier Stronghold
desc:
Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment.

The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

name: BUL-H4 Armor
desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.

name: BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo
desc:
Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.

Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

name: BUL-H4 Armor SteelTek
desc:
Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.

The SteelTek edition features a shining metallic silver with a mercurial pattern that runs across the surface.

name: BUL-H4 Armor Stronghold
desc:
Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.

The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

name: BUL-H4 Helmet
desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety.

name: BUL-H4 Helmet Snow Camo
desc:
Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety.

Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

name: BUL-H4 Helmet SteelTek
desc:
Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety.

The SteelTek edition features a shining metallic coating with a Damascus pattern that runs across the surface.

name: BUL-H4 Helmet Stronghold
desc:
Wreak havoc beyond belief while keeping your head intact with the XXXX helmet. With a full face visor and reinforced metal plating, plus extra internal padding to keep you comfortable, not just safe - you'll become a force to be reckoned with. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

name: Bulwark
desc: The Bulwark shield generator provides industrial-grade durability and increased performance, but at the expense of a higher emission level.

name: Burst
desc: With the Burst quantum drive, ArcCorp has taken their popular Rush model and through streamlined re-engineering, managed to improve upon it.

name: Buster's Chocolate Bar
desc: Smooth sesame paste, salty roasted nuts, and a rich chocolate coating all combine to make Buster's, the classic treat that the Empire has loved for over two hundred years. Buster's or Bust!

name: C-07T Cannon
desc: A dedicated anti-capital ship weapon adjusted to meet the combat demands of the Tiburon, the C-07T Ballistic Cannon delivers overwhelming offensive power, proving Behring continues to innovate in all areas of battlefield technology.

name: C-788 Cannon
desc: Hurtling high caliber rounds with devastating velocity, Behring's C-788 Ballistic Autocannon was built to punch through ship armor. Extremely durable with exceptional heat resistance, the "Combine" can handle a heavy workload that, even with the weapon's slower rate of fire, makes it an ideal choice for taking on larger, less maneuverable targets.

name: C54 "Justified" SMG
desc: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold with its purple accented styling, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. The "Justified" edition features a cool grey and bright red highlights.

name: C54 "Luckbringer" SMG
desc: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold with its purple accented styling, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. This special green and grey Luckbringer edition released for Stella Fortuna 2954 is a great way to get luck on your side.

name: Charger

name: Clash Arms
desc: Sometimes all you gotta do is put on the right piece of armor to make your message loud and clear. desc: Well-balanced performance is the hallmark of the ColdSnap cooler from Lightning Power Ltd., thanks to its ability to easily process the extra heat your ship generates during your day-to-day travels.

name: Colossus
desc: Juno Starwerk makes quantum drives that can go the distance and the Colossus is no exception. Though, once you experience its dependable performance for yourself, you might just want to call it exceptional.

name: Condemnation Distortion Scattergun
desc: The Condemnation is a massive size six scattergun from Preacher Armaments. Its high distortion damage incapacitates the electronics, though its wide spreads makes it less effective as the target gets farther away.

name: Conqueror-7
desc: Bring your conquest to the skies using Hurston Dynamics' Conqueror-7 ballistic cannon. Bespoke built for the Aegis Idris dorsal turret, these cannons are able to engage larger ships from a distance, finishing fights before they even begin.

name: CoolCore
desc: The name CoolCore says it all. Designed by Juno Starwerk to be as hardworking as you are, this cooler helps ensure that your entire ship operates well within desired temperature parameters.

name: Cryo-Star XL
desc: With its well-crafted design and dependable performance, the Cryo-Star XL cooler proves from the moment you use it that no one understands heat management better than J-Span.

As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management.

The Streamline edition is a subdued white finished with strokes of deep red and metallic accents.

desc: Though the Diligence delivers high performance compared to other components in its class, this power plant's dependability and ease of maintenance is what makes it a favorite of haulers.

name: Dominance-1 Scattergun
desc: Thanks to its integration of Hurston Dynamics' laser cascade technology, the Dominance-1 scattergun is able to deliver more damage the closer the size one weapon operates to its maximum safe thermal capacity.

name: Dominance-2 Scattergun
desc: The harder the fight, the harder the Dominance-2 scattergun works. As its thermal levels increase, the size two weapon from Hurston Dynamics is able utilize cascade technology to turn that thermal potential into an even deadlier close-quarters attack.

name: Dominance-3 Scattergun
desc: The Dominance-3 scattergun from Hurston Dynamics showcases the weapons manufacturer's cascade technology. As the operator continues to fire the size three weapon, the better able it is to convert the heat generated into increasingly devastating attacks.

name: Dominator II Missile
desc: Designed to track an opponent's electromagnetic signature, the Dominator strike missile is a precision ordnance package designed to establish tactical battlefield dominance.

name: Dominator II-G Missile
desc: Designed to track an opponent's electromagnetic signature, the Dominator strike missile is a precision ordnance package designed to establish tactical battlefield dominance. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

name: Double Dog

name: DR Model-XJ1 Repeater
desc: Power is the life blood of every ship, and the DR Model-XJ1 from ASD is the ideal choice to bleed hostiles dry. This cutting-edge distortion repeater allows you to disrupt power on targets, disabling threats efficiently.

name: DR Model-XJ2 Repeater
desc: Advancing the field of distortion weapons, the DR Model-XJ2 repeater from ASD provides tactical energy disruption that will severely limit any targeted ships operational capacity.

name: DR Model-XJ3 Repeater
desc: Shutdown hostile actions and target power supplies with the DR Model-XJ3, a well-ranged distortion repeater developed by the advanced weapons research labs of ASD.

name: Drassik
desc: The Drassik is a military-grade power plant from Aegis Dynamics. The large component is known for providing decent durability but unremarkable performance.

name: Draug
desc: The Draug balances performance, durability, and stealth. Making this large Wen/Cassel cooler ready to respond to any situation you find yourself in.

name: Draugar Gatling
desc: Reminiscent of a bygone era of space combat, this brutal size six ballistic Gatling from Apocalypse Arms is a very deliberate weapon. Take a moment as the Draugar's drum spins up to speed to savor the ruin and destruction that you are about unleash.

name: Drema Injector
desc: Designed by RRS for field applications, this single-use device injects a fast-acting sedative into the target's body that will incapacitate the subject for a short duration preventing them from hurting themselves or others.

name: Drift
desc: Built to keep heat and signature levels low, the Drift quantum drive from RAMP Corporation helps to minimize emissions generated while spooling.

name: Drifter
desc: Balancing craftsmanship and cost, the Drifter provides renowned Tarsus performance at an affordable price.

name: DuraJet
desc: The DuraJet is Lightning Power Ltd.'s base vehicle power plant. Not only does its design catch the eye, but its reliable construction and affordable price point make it a prime option to keep power flowing through your vehicle.

name: Durango
desc: The Durango is the peak of large power plants produced by Juno Starwerk. This top-of-the-line industrial component provides unmatched energy dispersion that minimizes fluctuations and surges during heavy demand.

name: Dust Devil Armor Arms

name: DynaFlux
desc: The DynaFlux was one of the first components A&R Co. built when they expanded their product line to more than energy weapons. Their years of experience manufacturing military-grade equipment went a long way to making the DynaFlux power plant a standout right from the beginning.

name: Echion Repeater
desc: Designed to overwhelm shields with a barrage of laserfire, this custom-made RSI Echion laser repeater will strip enemies of their defenses leaving them vulnerable to more devastating attacks.

name: Echo
desc: ArcCorp carefully crafted and calibrated the Echo into an affordable yet effective quantum drive.

name: Eclipse
desc: Competing medium power plants struggle to match the heat and signature reduction of the Eclipse. Tyler Design & Tech's mastery of stealth tech makes this component a must own by those who prefer to go unnoticed.

name: Eco-Flow
desc: A standard for centuries, Juno Starwerk's industrial Eco-Flow cooler is a favorite of haulers for being easy to maintain even when carrying the heaviest cargo loads.

name: EE04 (4x Telescopic)
desc: Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE04. Behring craftsmanship produced a 4x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE04 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

name: EE08 (8x Telescopic)
desc: Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE08. Behring craftsmanship produced a 8x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE08 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

name: Elsen
desc: Wen/Cassel engineers used many of the same parts found in the Draug, only fine tuned to deliver improved performance and durability without greatly enhancing its signature. That makes the Elsen large cooler a worthy upgrade for those that can handle the extra heat.

name: Emod "Scorched" Stabilizer1
desc: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer1 attachment to improve spread for a slower but more precise shot. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

name: Emod "Tweaker" Stabilizer2
desc: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer2 attachment to improve heat distribution and visual stability allowing for a more precise shot. This "Tweaker" version has been unofficially modified to do more damage at the cost of expending more energy.

name: Emod Stabilizer1
desc: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer1 attachment to improve visual stability allowing for a more precise shot.

name: Emod Stabilizer2
desc: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer2 attachment to improve visual stability allowing for a more precise shot.

name: Emod Stabilizer3
desc: Reduce energy weapon recoil with the Emod Stabilizer3. ArmaMod designed the attachment to improve both horizontal and vertical recoil to ensure a more precise shot.

name: Endo
desc: A cooler for discerning ship-owners who are looking to push their craft further, Wen/Cassel's Endo features above average cooling performance and thoughtful design.

name: Endurance
desc: Juno Starwerk's Endurance has been in service since the 26th century. This industrial strength, utilitarian power plant is a favorite of mechanics since spare parts are easily acquired.

name: Eos
desc: The Eos quantum drive has been a staple in the RSI product line for centuries. Its original design was so perfectly fine-tuned that it has remained basically unchanged since.

name: Erebos
desc: The Erebos exemplifies RSI's commitment to excellence. This high quality quantum drive constantly ranks atop "Best of" lists for both critics and consumers.

name: Ermer Family Farms Chibanzoo Ice Cream
desc: This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with all natural chunks of Chibanzoo fruit is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

name: Ermer Family Farms Chocolate Ice Cream
desc: This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with rich creamy chocolate is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

name: Ermer Family Farms Chocolate Milk
desc: This premium 100% real dairy milk blended with rich chocolate is bottled fresh at Ermer Family Farms.

name: Ermer Family Farms Coffee Ice Cream
desc: This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with freshly brewed medium-roast coffee is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

name: Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream
desc: This premium 100% fat free, real dairy ice cream blended with natural vanilla is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

name: Ermer Family Farms Lunes Ice Cream
desc: This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with all natural Lunes fruit puree is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

name: Escalate Stabilizer1
desc: ArmaMod's enhanced circuitry in the Escalate Stabilizer1 boosts the output of handheld weapons substantially, trading control for power.

name: Escalate Stabilizer2
desc: Unleash the full destructive potential of your weapon with the Escalate Stabilizer2, increasing the fire rate and shot spread at the cost of accuracy.

name: Escalate Stabilizer3
desc: By allowing for increased energy consumption, the Escalate Stabilizer3 can overclock your weapon to significantly reduce charge time and increase damage output.

name: EVSD Cannon
desc: Disable ships without hurting their crew or cargo with the EVSD from Behring. This distortion cannon features much of the same industry-leading technology used in other Behring weapons, but is specifically designed to be mounted on the nose of an Aegis Vanguard.

name: EX-T10-CS "Executor" Torpedo
desc: Behring prides itself on crafting ordnance that is as dependable as it is powerful and the EX-T10 "Executor" is no exception. Designed as an anti-ship and anti-installation weapon, Behring engineers worked tirelessly to ensure this torpedo was a bold strategic statement.

name: Fieldsbury Dark Bear Helmet

Ever since, the bear's big, toothy grin and off-set flickering eyes have become a standard sight at Day of the Vara celebrations. Now CC's Conversions has designed and delivered an official, high quality reproduction of this iconic mascot, available in six striking colors.

name: FL-11 Cannon
desc: Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. The FL-11 might shoot slow but provides considerable firepower for a size one weapon.

name: FL-22 Cannon
desc: Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. The size two FL-22 shines at medium and long ranges thanks to a design that minimizes damage falloff.

name: FL-33 Cannon
desc: Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. Embodying Kroneg's practical design philosophy, the FL-33 remains one of the most reliable and destructive size three laser cannons currently available.

name: Flash
desc: With improved spooling and calibration, the new ArcCorp Flash drive can get you in and out of quantum easier and faster.

name: FlashFreeze
desc: With the FlashFreeze, Lightning Power makes sure that no matter how hot things get, you can rely on its proven cooling technology to keep you flying.

name: Flood

name: Flood Energy

name: Fresnel "Deepwater" Energy LMG
desc:
The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management.

name: Fried Seanut
desc: Easy to grow and care for, these tubular sea creatures have become a popular food in the outer reaches of systems. This seanut has been fried and has a salty, roasted flavor.

name: Frost-Star EX

name: Frost-Star SL
desc: Whether cruising across the ground or sailing through space, there's a J-Span cooler perfect for you. The Frost-Star SL is a mid-tier cooler designed to bring the line's reliability to ground and open-canopy vehicles.

name: Frost-Star XL
desc: As your ship flies, components generate heat that can be damaging and even lead to system failures unless properly dealt with by a dependable and properly designed cooler like the Frost-Star XL from J-Span.

name: FrostBite
desc: Keep your ship running smoothly with the Lightning Power FrostBite handling your thermal management needs. This consumer-grade cooler can process extra-heat and help maintain optimal running temperatures for all your components.

name: FrostBurn
desc: Lightning Power Ltd. has put its years of design expertise and manufacturing know-how to craft the FrostBurn, an effective cooler that can handle the large scale heat management needs of a wide variety of ships on the market.

name: GCD-Army Arms
desc: In honor of the soldiers who protect the Empire, CDS has crafted this limited-edition armor that proudly displays the seal of the UEE Army. Its shell is composed of a durable composite on the outside and a soft core on the inside, designed to absorb the types of impacts associated with on-the-ground combat. The matching helmet features a UV-blocking faceplate that protects the wearer's eye sight as they fight on the front lines under strange suns.

name: Gelid
desc: Allowing for greater thermo-dispersal and improved performance output, the top-of-the-line Gelid cooler from Wen/Cassel is an all-inclusive heat management system ideal for a variety of ships.

name: Gen Liberty Ale (Bottle)
desc: Liberty Lake beer has been brewed by families on Terra for generations to provide a crisp, clean ale perfect to partake when you arrive at those little moments made to be spent enjoying life. Gen Liberty is a tart lactic ale perfect for warm nights.

name: Genoa
desc: According to Juno Starwerk, good industrial design is meant to go unnoticed, yet it's hard not to marvel at the Genoa medium power plant, as its outstanding performance and noted durability make it a first-rate component.

name: Get Up Coffee  (Milk)
desc: Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. A splash of milk rounds out the flavor and emphasizes its natural sweetness.

name: Get Up Coffee (Black)
desc: Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. Served black and unsweetened, enjoy coffee in its purest expression.

name: Get Up Coffee (Cinnamon)
desc: Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. A touch of cinnamon is the perfect accent to awaken your taste buds even more.

name: Get Up Coffee (Decaf)
desc: Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. Our decaf replaces the caffeine typically found in coffee with other natural and gentle stimulants.

name: Get Up Coffee (Mocha)
desc: Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. Enjoy your break even more with Mocha, our coffee enhanced with a swirl of chocolate and milk.

name: Ginzel
desc: The unique name for this stalwart industrial power plant was inspired by the nickname of a Juno Starwerk junior engineer who helped design it.

name: Giocoso Racing Helmet Azure
desc: Inspired by the sleek stylings of the 100 series, the Giocoso is a helmet worthy of Origin Jumpworks. It features a wide face shield to provide excellent peripheral vision and a special internal air flow system to dissipate heat and humidity. In a nod to the 100 series, the back of the helmet slyly integrates the iconic shape language of the ship's tail into the form.

name: Giocoso Racing Helmet Ivory
desc: Inspired by the sleek stylings of the 100 series, the Giocoso is a helmet worthy of Origin Jumpworks. It features a wide face shield to provide excellent peripheral vision and a special internal air flow system to dissipate heat and humidity. In a nod to the 100 series, the back of the helmet slyly integrates the iconic shape language of the ship's tail into the form.

desc: Inspired by the sleek stylings of the 100 series, the Giocoso is a helmet worthy of Origin Jumpworks. In a nod to the 100 series, the back of the helmet slyly integrates the iconic shape language of the ship's tail into the form.

name: Glacier
desc: Your weapons, your shields, your thrusters. All vital during combat, all generating heat. Enter the Glacier cooler from Aegis Dynamics. A best-in-class heat management system designed to keep you cool as the pressure mounts.

name: Glacis
desc: Origin turned to the experts at Basilisk to build a bespoke shield generator for the 890 Jump. The Glacis blends centuries of cutting edge innovation to produce a strong and stable shield capable of defending the valuable ship and passengers aboard.

name: Glacis
desc: Origin turned to the experts at Basilisk to build a bespoke shield generator for the 890 Jump. The Glacis blends centuries of cutting edge innovation to produce a strong and stable shield capable of defending the valuable ship and passengers aboard.

name: Godmother Sandwich
desc: Layers of cured meats and salami are stacked high with tangy fosso cheese, tomatoes, lettuce, roasted peppers and our famous house dressing on rice bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

name: Goliath
desc: The Goliath was designed to be more durable than other quantum drives in its class. That's made it a staple of industrial ship since Humanity first started to explore the stars.

name: GP-33 MOD "Ashfall" Grenade Launcher
desc: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. The Ashfall edition mixes dark blue, grey, and black for a subtle yet stylish look.

name: GP-33 MOD "Copperhead" Grenade Launcher
desc: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. A light, metallic finish applied to the barrel and stock catches the eye and makes the Copperhead edition stand out from other versions.

name: GP-33 MOD "Quite Useful" Grenade Launcher
desc: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. One of the many items Wikelo has acquired in his travels, the 'Quite Useful' edition is a must have for any serious collector.

name: GP-33 MOD "Thunderclap" Grenade Launcher
desc: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. A black and grey color combination gives the Thunderclap edition a subtle look suitable for any security professional.

name: GP-33 MOD "Umber" Grenade Launcher
desc: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. The Umber edition is finished in rust and orange.

name: GP-33 MOD Grenade Launcher
desc: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact.

name: GP-33 MOD Grenade Launcher Magazine (6 cap)
desc: This magazine for the GP-33 MOD holds six 40mm grenades.

name: Graupel
desc: The Graupel not only provides the top of the line cooling technology that larger ships need to maintain optimal performance, it does it with Wen/Cassel's signature craftsmanship.

name: Green Blend Smoothie
desc: A smoothie made with a fresh blend of healthy greens.

name: Green QuikFlarePro
desc: Illuminate the way forward or signal for help with the Green QuikFlarePro from Shubin Interstellar. For centuries, miners have counted on this flare as part of their core toolkit, thanks to its tried and true design and durability that ensures it stays ablaze in the various harsh weather and difficult atmospheric conditions encountered across the 'verse. The QuikFlarePro uses advanced tech to glow longer than regular flares.

name: Green Vitality Smoothie
desc: Garcia's Greens Green Vitality Smoothie is a blend of vital nutrients densely packed into this bright combination of leafy greens.

name: GUARD
desc: Don't be afraid to go up against the unknown with Seal Corp's GUARD. This shield generator balances performance, durability, and stealth to allow the user to utilize the shield in whatever way suits them best.

name: Guardian
desc: Upgrade to the Guardian for increased absorption of ballistic, energy, and distortion damage. Making this industrial shield generator one of the most durable in its class.

name: GVSR Repeater
desc: Aegis commissioned Behring to design a laser repeater specifically for their Vanguard line-up. The result was the GVSR, which met Aegis exacting standards by delivering a steady rate of fire without overtaxing the ship's power plant.

name: GVSR Repeater
desc: Aegis commissioned Behring to design a laser repeater specifically for their Vanguard line-up. The result was the GVSR, which met Aegis exacting standards by delivering a steady rate of fire without overtaxing the ship's power plant.

name: H4-PBF Ammo Carrier
desc: Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment.

name: H4-PBF Ammo Carrier Snow Camo
desc:
Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment.

Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

name: H4-PBF Ammo Carrier SteelTek
desc:
Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment.

The SteelTek edition features a shining metallic coating with a Damascus pattern that runs across the surface.

name: Haltur
desc: Strong shield health and an exceptional generation rate gives the Haltur the best performance ranking of any shield in its class. Beloved by racers and those who prefer to navigate away from danger instead of soaking it up.

name: Handmade Glazed Mug
desc: This slab-built pottery mug with ridged detailing was crafted by hand and finished with a speckled glaze.

name: HAVEN
desc: The HAVEN is an admired shield generator for large ships. Seal Corp's simple, clean design makes repairing the component an easy and affordable task, and has only increased its popularity over the years.

name: Havoc Scattergun
desc: Sow dread across the battlefield with the Havoc from Apocalypse Arms. This size one scattergun deals massive damage at close range, making it the perfect weapon for finishing a fight.

name: Havoc Scattergun Sharkmouth Edition
desc: Sow dread across the battlefield with the Havoc from Apocalypse Arms. This size one scattergun deals massive damage at close range, making it the perfect weapon for finishing a fight.

name: HeatSafe
desc: Pilots looking to keep their IR signature low rely on Tyler Design & Tech. As an entry level cooler, the HeatSafe not only limits emissions, it is built with Tyler's satisfaction guarantee.

name: HeatSink
desc: The HeatSink produces low signatures without sacrificing too much performance or durability, making it a reliable stealth component.

name: Helix I Mining Laser
desc: To some, the effective use of the Helix I has become a sign of a true mining professional. Thermyte Concern gave the laser impressive power that can bypass a deposit's resistance but also requires precision handling to hit the optimal charge window. Best deployed at close range, Helix I features two module slots so miners can tailor the laser to their liking.

name: Helix II Mining Laser
desc: To some, the effective use of the Helix II has become a sign of a true mining professional. Thermyte Concern gave the laser impressive power that can bypass a deposit's resistance but also requires precision handling to hit the optimal charge window. Best deployed at close range, Helix II features three module slots so miners can tailor the laser to their liking.

name: Hellion Scattergun
desc: Apocalypse Arms' Hellion is a size two scattergun that saturates targets with ballistic ammo in close quarters. The gun's smart ammo functionality allows it to switch between standard and specialty rounds.

name: Hellion Scattergun Sharkmouth Edition
desc: Apocalypse Arms' Hellion is a size two scattergun that saturates targets with ballistic ammo in close quarters. The gun's smart ammo functionality allows it to switch between standard and specialty rounds.

name: Hellion VII Missile
desc: Carrying a sizable payload and an advanced heat-seeking sensor suite, the Hellion missile from Talon can be effective against aggressors of all sizes.

name: Hellion VII-G Missile
desc: Carrying a sizable payload and an advanced heat-seeking sensor suite, the Hellion missile from Talon can be effective against aggressors of all sizes. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

name: Hemera
desc: Designing the Hemera quantum drive has allowed the technicians at Robert Space Industries to push the boundaries of quantum travel technology even further, and allow you to go even farther.

name: HEX
desc: Prepare your ship for any circumstance by installing a HEX from Seal Corporation. Balanced performance and durability make this an ideal, versatile choice for those who don't know where their next adventure may take them.

name: HG-15 Jaeger (1.5x Holographic)
desc: HG-15 Jaeger's features a low power variable magnification providing flexibility when engaging hostiles at close and longer ranges.

name: HG-2 Jaeger (2x Holographic)
desc: Specializing in medium distance combat, the HG-2 Jaeger excels in situations where you want to keep your distance from hostiles.

name: HG-3 Jaeger (3x Holographic)
desc: Featuring KLWE's proprietary NocturnaLite hardware, the HG-3 Jaeger provides enhanced vision in low-light situations.

name: Hofstede-S1 Mining Laser
desc: The Hofstede-S1 was designed with a patented crystal lattice structure that dampens a deposit's natural resistance while mining and gathers less inert materials when extracting. Most effective at short and medium range, an accompanying increase in instability means the laser should be managed carefully.

name: Hofstede-S2 Mining Laser
desc: The Hofstede-S2 was designed with a patented crystal lattice structure that dampens a deposit's natural resistance while mining and gathers less inert materials when extracting. name: Holdstrong
desc: This capital-class shield generator was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

name: Holdstrong

name: Holiday Butcher Helmet
desc: Celebrate the season with the festive Holiday Butcher helmet. Doomsday designed this twisted bit of armor to withstand a firefight, raucous holiday party, and everything in between. The snout's custom armor plating provides protection while remaining lightweight, and the synthetic spiral horns are more durable than the real deal. The Holiday Butcher adds to Doomsday's reputation as the universe's premiere engineer of warped gear. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

name: Horizon Helmet
desc: RSI's Horizon helmet is a durable and robust environmental enclosed work helmet. The single sheet laminate dome gives you an extremely wide field of view. A pair of side-mounted LED light modules provide additional illumination to make sure you can see what you're doing.

desc: RSI's Horizon helmet is a durable and robust environmental enclosed work helmet. The single sheet laminate dome gives you an extremely wide field of view. name: Huracan
desc: Juno Starwerk understands that your most important job is to keep your cargo safe. That's why their Huracan quantum drive prioritizes interdiction shielding, stability, and damage efficiency above everything else.

name: Hydrocel
desc: Keep your ship working harder for longer with the durable Hydrocel, an entry-level industrial cooler from respected manufacturer Juno Starwerk.

name: HydroJet
desc: When your ship overheats, it makes just about any task not only more difficult, but potentially dangerous for you and your crew. With the entry-level HydroJet from Juno Starwerk installed, you can be confident that your heat levels are being controlled by a cooler designed by one of the most trustworthy names in the industry.

name: Hydropulse
desc: An entry level option to Juno Starwerk's brand of coolers, the Hydropulse sacrifices some durability and utilizes some design tricks to make this large industrial cooler an option for those unable to afford one of their top of the line models.

name: HyperGen
desc: The HyperGen power plant is popular among both civilians and the military for its high quality. As a bonus, the manufacture, Amon & Reese, is famous for its stellar customer service.

name: Hyperion
desc: In honor of the name, the first test flight destination for this popular RSI quantum drive was the similarly named satellite of Saturn.

name: Ice-Flush
desc: The Juno Starwerk Ice-Flush cooler is built to withstand the heat demands and thermal strains that many industrial ships deal with as part of their average workday.

name: IceBox
desc: The IceBox is an upgrade to the company's standard medium cooler, as the team at Tyler Design & Tech made a number of subtle modifications and material upgrades that lowered the component's signatures without greatly affecting its durability.

name: IceDive
desc: The IceDive delivers peak performance over other medium coolers of its grade, though it does come at the cost of generating high IR and EM signatures.

name: IcePlunge
desc: When you're pushing your ship to the limit during that frantic last lap, you'll be glad you have ACOM's IcePlunge to keep things cool.

name: Ignite II Missile
desc: The Ignite is Firestorm's premier brand of heat-seeking strike missile that is the definition of Fire and Forget. Simply let it fly and enjoy the show.

name: Ignite II-G Missile
desc: The Ignite is Firestorm's premier brand of heat-seeking strike missile that is the definition of Fire and Forget. Simply let it fly and enjoy the show. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

name: Impact I Mining Laser
desc: The Impact I excels in a variety of mining situations. Special focus lenses make it easier to work a deposit by stabilizing the laser and increasing the optimal charge window. There are drawbacks, including increased deposit resistance and a slower filling optimal charge window, but Thermyte Concern also provided two module slots to allow miners to better customize the laser to the task at hand.

name: Impact II Mining Laser
desc: The Impact II excels in a variety of mining situations. Special focus lenses make it easier to work a deposit by stabilizing the laser and increasing the optimal charge window. name: M2C "Swarm"
desc: The latest generation of point-defense technology, the M2C "Swarm" utilizes advanced search, detection, and tracking software to unleash a swift barrage of laserfire, protecting ships from incoming missiles, torpedoes, and other high-speed threats.

name: M3A Cannon
desc: The M3A is Behring's entry level laser autocannon. The autocannon configuration offers modest damage per projectile and a fairly low rate of fire. As the most basic offering in Behring's weapons lineup, it features low power consumption, but poor power efficiency. It makes up ground for its shortcomings by being cheap, a feature many pilots are looking for when outfitting their ships on a budget.

name: M3A Cannon Defense Division
desc:
The M3A is Behring's entry level laser autocannon. The autocannon configuration offers modest damage per projectile and a fairly low rate of fire. As the most basic offering in Behring's weapons lineup, it features low power consumption, but poor power efficiency. It makes up ground for its shortcomings by being cheap, a feature many pilots are looking for when outfitting their ships on a budget.

The Defense Division edition features a gray, urban camo pattern and was given to those who assisted Alliance Aid's Defense Division during Levski's time of need.

name: M4A Cannon
desc: The M4A is Behring's second tier laser autocannon. Its bigger size means more power consumption in exchange for packing a bigger punch. Fire rate and power efficiency are comparable to the M3A model.

It makes up ground for its shortcomings by being cheap, a feature many pilots are looking for when outfitting their ships on a budget.

The Defense Division edition features a gray, urban camo pattern and was given to those who assisted Alliance Aid's Defense Division during Levski's time of need.

name: M6A Cannon

desc: Behring's Marksman series of proximity missiles has earned as much of a reputation for its ability to track a wide range of heat signatures as it has for its area-effect proximity damage.

desc: Behring's Marksman series of proximity missiles has earned as much of a reputation for its ability to track a wide range of heat signatures as it has for its area-effect proximity damage. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

name: Mauler Cooler
desc: This Vanduul cooler processes the excessive heat generated by the Mauler during intense combat.

name: Mauler Power Plant
desc: The Vanduul Mauler's built-in Power Plant generates enough energy for the operation of essential systems, even in heavy combat.

name: Mauler Quantum Drive
desc: This Quantum Drive has been calibrated to allow for the Mauler to undertake long and short quantum travel as well as access jump points.

name: Mauler Shield Generator
desc: The Mauler's shield generator provides defensive coverage against incoming fire and other threats to the ship.

name: MaxLift AA Support Tractor Beam
desc:
Greycat's heavy duty tractor beam boasts industrial performance at a consumer-friendly price. With its longer-lasting battery and wider beam emitter, the MaxLift can easily manipulate heavier and bulkier items making it the perfect tool for long days of hauling cargo.

The AA Support edition features a sharp red coloring and is intended for those who assisted Levski during their time of need.

name: MaxLift AA Transport Tractor Beam
desc:
Greycat's heavy duty tractor beam boasts industrial performance at a consumer-friendly price. With its longer-lasting battery and wider beam emitter, the MaxLift can easily manipulate heavier and bulkier items making it the perfect tool for long days of hauling cargo.

The AA Transport edition features a metallic green coloring and was intended for those who assisted Alliance Aid's Transport Division during Levski's time of need.

name: MaxLift Tractor Beam Battery

name: Meat Skewer
desc: Chunks of what is most definitely meat that have been skewered and roasted.

name: Medivac Rescue Light
desc: Utilizing multiple vibrant lights housed in a compact durable frame, the Rescue Light is capable at being seen from all directions in all kinds of hazardous atmospheric conditions, letting rescue teams know exactly where you are.

name: MedPen (Hemozal)
desc: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife MedPen can rapidly dispense doses of the coagulant Hemozal during emergency situations to help relieve bleeding and improve a patient's overall vitals. Use only as recommended.

name: MegaFlux
desc: Repeated requests from military veterans to make the MegaFlux commercially available convinced A&R Co. to release this large power plant to the public.

name: Melty Dog

name: Mercury
desc: In combat situations, even the smallest advantage can lead to big gains. With Aegis' Mercury cooling system onboard, you'll be able to push your ship hotter for longer when you need it most.

name: Merguez Sandwich

name: Metis
desc: There's no room for error when bending space and time to travel incredible distances. So put your trust in RSI, a company that's delivered quality components to the public since the dawn of space flight.

name: MRX "Torrent"
desc: The latest generation of point-defense technology, the MRX "Torrent" utilizes advanced search, detection, and tracking software to unleash a swift barrage of ballistic fire, protecting ships from incoming missiles, torpedoes, and other high-speed threats.

name: Musaka Burrito
desc: This satisfying burrito features a tortilla wrapper filled with spiced vegetables and lentils in a creamy sauce.

name: MVSA Cannon
desc: The classic M4A has been specially retooled by Behring to create the VS (Vanguard Special), a laser weapon designed to meet the Aegis' unique requirements. The default nose-mounted weapon on the Vanguard Warden, the MVSA can only be loaded onto other Vanguard variants.

name: Myers (4x Telescopic)
desc: Exquisitely crafted by the gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks, the Myers scope was designed to pair with the graceful lines of their stately Arlington rifle.

name: Myondo Knife
desc: The Myondo is a distinct, curved blade with a notched finger-well and bejeweled pommel. The texture on both the blade and handle come from the unique forging process used by the Banu craftsmen who make them.

name: Myuda Knife
desc: A brutally effective product of Banu engineering, the Myuda knife is a vicious weapon designed for leaving wounds that won't heal easily. The proprietary metal alloy used in the construction of the blade is rust-resistant and remains ultra-sharp even after extensive use. The intricately detailed handle gives it a distinctly Banu style and provides texture to ensure a tight grip.

name: NDB-26 Repeater
desc: The NDB-26 uses a twin barrel system to fire neutron projectiles at a rapid rate. Devastating at close range, this neutron repeater still packs enough of a wallop at medium range to persuade any attackers to reconsider their assault.

name: NDB-28 Repeater
desc: Featuring a sleek, scientific design, the MaxOx NDB-28 is the next step in serious stopping power. Twin barrels overlap blasts for sustained neutron fire that remains effective at short to medium range.

name: NDB-30 Repeater
desc: Decades of design work went into perfecting the NDB line of neutron repeaters. The S3 NDB-30 rapidly fires powerful and precise neutron projectiles that will quickly deter anyone foolish enough to get too close.

name: Neoni Jami Helmet
desc: Show that you serve no master with the Neoni helmet. Drawing inspiration from monster myths and warrior cultures of old, this menacing visage courtesy of CC's Conversions features a dramatic paint job, fang-filled grin, and pointed holographic horns, providing protection and intimidation in one memorable helmet. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

name: Neoni Tengubi Helmet
desc: Show that you serve no master with the Neoni helmet. name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit BlackFire
desc: A racing flight suit that fits like a second skin without skimping on style, the Neutrino BlackFire edition has a sleek monochrome profile enhanced by pale gray accents and offers a low-key combination of looks and protection, allowing you to concentrate on what matters most: winning.

name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit BlueFlame
desc: Cut a dashing figure in this Neutrino racing flight suit. Fitting like a second skin without skimping on style, this special BlueFlame edition sports a dark blue profile enhanced by red and white accents offers a combination of eye-catching style and function, allowing you to concentrate on what matters most: winning.

name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit Fortuna
desc: Need a bit of luck to help you cross the finish line? Sakura Sun's exclusive Fortuna edition of the Neutrino Racing Flight Suit in green with shimmering accents may be just the thing to turn your fortune around.

name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit Mirai
desc: The Neutrino Racing Flight Suit uses synthetic fabrics sourced from Xi'an artisans to create a comfortable flight suit durable enough to endure the stresses of high-velocity racing. Taking inspiration from traditional Saisei culture and aesthetics, the stark red stripe across the body of this special Mirai edition results in a striking but elegant design.

name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit Murray Cup
desc: Bold neon yellow and vivid blue combine to make the special edition Neutrino racing flight suit stand out from the crowd. Designed to the same standards as the flight suits worn by professional racers, it features logos from official sponsors to mimic the Murray Cup racer suits.

name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit Origin
desc: Embody luxury, style, and speed by stepping into this Sakura Sun Neutrino flight suit, inspired by those worn by the Origin racing team. This officially sanctioned crisp white flight suit features blue and grey highlight and the Origin logo in several prominent places.

name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit Star Kitten
desc: The limited edition Neutrino racing flight suit embraces the iconic look of the cartoon character Star Kitten. Inspired by those worn by Team Takahashi racers, the flight suit is primarily pink with teal highlights and large images of Star Kitten on the front and back.

name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit WhiteHot
desc: Make an unmissable statement in this Neutrino racing flight suit. Fitting like a second skin without skimping on style, the WhiteHot edition's pure-white profile enhanced by red accents offers a combination of eye-catching style and function, allowing you to concentrate on what matters most: winning.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet BlackFire
desc: Sakura Sun utilises advanced Xi'an materials to create a comfortable, lightweight helmet durable enough to handle the stresses of high-velocity racing. The Neutrino BlackFire edition helmet features a dark gray finish paired with a sleek, minimalist aesthetic.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet BlueFlame
desc: Sakura Sun utilises advanced Xi'an materials to create a comfortable, lightweight helmet durable enough to handle the stresses of high-velocity racing. The Neutrino BlueFlame edition helmet features a deep blue and red finish paired with a sleek, minimalist aesthetic.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Fortuna
desc: Need a bit of luck to help you cross the finish line? Sakura Sun's exclusive Fortuna edition of the Neutrino Racing Helmet in shimmering green may be just the thing to turn your fortune around.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Mirai
desc: The Neutrino Racing Helmet uses advanced Xi'an materials to create a comfortable, lightweight helmet durable enough to endure the stresses of high-velocity racing. Taking inspiration from traditional Saisei culture and aesthetics, the stark red highlight and special edition Mirai branding results in a striking but elegant design.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Murray Cup
desc: This special edition Neutrino racing helmet was made to pay homage to Murray Cup racers. Neon yellow, blue, and packed full of logos from official race sponsors, the helmet is both lightweight and supremely comfortable.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Origin
desc: Plunge headlong into extreme speed in comfort and style with this special edition Origin-inspired Neutrino racing helmet. Primarily white with black and blue highlights, the helmet features a wide visor for unobstructed views as you speed by.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Star Kitten
desc: Sakura Sun's take on the iconic racing helmet worn by Team Takahashi racers can now be yours. This special edition Neutrino helmet features vibrant pink with Star Kitten iconography on the front and back, plus playful teal whiskers across the faceplate.

name: Neutrino Racing Helmet WhiteHot
desc: The Neutrino racing helmet utilises advanced Xi'an materials to create a comfortable, lightweight design durable enough to handle the stresses of high-velocity racing. The WhiteHot edition features a bright white and red finish paired with a sleek, minimalist aesthetic.

name: NewDawn
desc: The NewDawn was appropriately named, as it was the first large power plant built by Sakura Sun. Following its commercial success, the company decided to expand and improve upon their line of large power plants.

name: NightFall
desc: Run silent and safe with the NightFall from Tyler Design & Tech. Few coolers can match the way this component manages your ship's heat while also keeping its signatures low.

name: Njakte Knife
desc: Banu engineering and ingenuity combine in the Njakte knife. Its distinct curved blade and serrated edge is rust resistant and remains ultra-sharp even after extensive use thanks to a proprietary metal alloy that's a trade secret of the souli that manufacturers it. The intricately detailed handle gives it a distinctly Banu visual style and provides texture to ensure a great grip.

name: NN-13 Cannon
desc: MaxOx's NN-13 neutron cannon offers a massive energy payload at the expense of speed and energy efficiency. One could argue the virtues of speed, rate of fire and distance over damage, but the argument becomes irrelevant if you only need to hit them once.

name: NN-14 Cannon
desc: Building on the technology of the NN-13, MaxOx's NN-14 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.

name: NN-15 Cannon
desc: Building on the technology of the successful NN-series, MaxOx's NN-15 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.

name: Odyssey Helmet Tan
desc: RSI's Odyssey helmet is so light and unobtrusive, you'll almost forget you're wearing it. The durable impact-resistant carbon fiber construction with shock-absorbing foam inserts and a single piece molded laminate visor that provides maximum field of view horizontally and vertically.
